data.text:
M/S Ravenbhel Health Care Private ... vs Union Territory
Through Food Safety ... on 18 March, 2024
 Serial No. 156
 Supplementary L
 High Court Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh 
 At Srinagar
 Crm(M) 117/2024
 CrlM(310/2024) CrlM(311/2024).
 M/S Ravenbhel Health Care Private Limited And Ors.
 ...Petitioner (s)
 Through: Mr. F.A. Wani, Advocate.
 Versus
 Union Territory Through Food Safety Officer Block Bandipora. 
 ...Respondent(s)
 Through:
Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Sekhri, Judge
 Order
18.03.2024 CrlM No. 310/2024. 
For the reasons stated in the application the same is allowed and the requirement for filing certified copy of complaint is dispensed with for the time being and same shall be filed within two weeks. 
The application disposed of Notice in the main as well as CM returnable within a period of two weeks'. Requisites be filed within a week's time. 
Dasti in addition is also permitted. List on 19.04.2024. 
(Rajesh Sekhri) Judge SRINAGAR 18.03.2024.
